name: Tomato Sauce
ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 large onion, finely diced
1 packet of cherry tomatoes
1 carrot (optional)
1 red pepper (optional)
1 chilli pepper
3 large cloves garlic, minced
3 (400g) tins plum tomatoes
1 chicken stock cube
Rosemary
2 tablespoons tomato puree
1 tsp sugar
directions:
Step 1 - Preparation 
    + Chop the ONION
    + Dice the CARROT (optional)
    + Dice the GARLIC
    + Dice the RED PEPPER (optional)

Step 2 - Roast
    + Roast the ONION, CARROT, GARLIC, RED PEPPER, TOMATOES and ROSEMARY

Step 3  - Cook
    + Fry OLIVE OIL and CHILLI PEPPER 
    + Add roasted ingredients, PLUM TOMATOES, TOMATO PUREE, SUGAR, STOCK
    + Simmer 15 minutes
    + Puree in blender
